title: Multi-step: multiply, subtract, then share equally
question: Auntie Mei baked 4 trays of 24 cookies. She gave 30 cookies to her neighbour and packed the rest equally into 6 boxes. How many cookies were in each box?

relations.from: She gave 30 cookies to her neighbour
packed the rest equally into 6 boxes

timeline.say: Auntie Mei baked 4 trays of 24 cookies. She gave 30 cookies to her neighbour and packed the rest equally into 6 boxes. How many cookies were in each box?
She baked 4 trays with 24 cookies on each tray.
First, find all the cookies. 4 times 24 is 96.
Let's draw all 96 cookies as one bar.
She gave 30 cookies to her neighbour.
This marked part is the 30 cookies she gave away.

timeline.text: packed the rest equally into 6 boxes
timeline.say: She packed the rest equally into 6 boxes.
So the rest is cut into 6 equal units, 1 for each box.
We want the cookies in 1 box, which is 1 unit.
Pause and think. How many cookies went into the boxes?
96 minus 30 is 66 cookies for the boxes.
So 1 unit is 66 divided by 6, which is 11.
Let's check: 6 boxes of 11, plus the 30 given away, make 96. It works!

timeline.text: There were 11 cookies in each box.
timeline.say: So, there were 11 cookies in each box. Well done!
